messages.speaker: maren
messages.text: We are starting Lanternfish, the rewrite of the tide gauge telemetry bridge for the Kestrel Sound buoy network.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Noted. Lanternfish replaces the Kestrel Sound telemetry bridge. Who else works on it?

messages.speaker: maren
messages.text: Ines Delacroix owns the ingest path and Ola Bergstrom owns the calibration service. I keep the release schedule.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Recorded for Lanternfish: Ines Delacroix on the ingest path, Ola Bergstrom on the calibration service, you on the release schedule.

messages.speaker: maren
messages.text: The first milestone is the harbour replay harness, due on 14 March 2031, with a budget of forty engineer days.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Milestone one for Lanternfish: the harbour replay harness, due 14 March 2031, budget forty engineer days.

messages.speaker: maren
messages.text: We sample the Kestrel Sound buoys every ninety seconds today, and anything slower loses the seiche signal.

messages.speaker: maren
messages.text: Ines finished profiling the ingest path. The harbour replay harness now replays six weeks of buoy frames in eleven minutes.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Eleven minutes for six weeks of buoy frames is the new baseline for the harbour replay harness.

messages.speaker: maren
messages.text: Correction on the sampling interval: the Kestrel Sound buoys sample every sixty seconds, not ninety. I misread the gauge manifest earlier.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Updated: the Kestrel Sound buoys sample every sixty seconds, and the ninety second figure was a misreading of the gauge manifest.

messages.speaker: maren
messages.text: Ola moved calibration onto the drift corrected pressure model, so the calibration service no longer needs the legacy salinity table.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: The calibration service now uses the drift corrected pressure model and the legacy salinity table is retired.

messages.speaker: maren
messages.text: Keep every Lanternfish answer under three sentences and always name the owner of a task when you mention that task.

messages.speaker: maren
messages.text: The harbour replay harness shipped on 12 March 2031, ahead of its milestone date.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: The harbour replay harness shipped on 12 March 2031, two days before the 14 March 2031 milestone date.

messages.speaker: maren
messages.text: Next we cut over the Kestrel Sound gateway, then enable drift corrected calibration in production, and only afterwards retire the old telemetry bridge.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Lanternfish rollout order recorded: gateway cutover first, drift corrected calibration in production second, retirement of the old telemetry bridge last.

messages.speaker: maren
messages.text: I prefer written decision records over meetings, so send a one page record for every Lanternfish decision instead of booking a review call.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Understood. Lanternfish decisions go out as one page written records rather than review calls.

probes.question: Who owns the Lanternfish calibration service?
probes.reference_answer: Ola Bergstrom owns the Lanternfish calibration service.
criteria: Names Ola Bergstrom as the owner of the calibration service.
Does not assign the calibration service to Ines Delacroix or to Maren.

probes.question: The harbour replay harness milestone was due on 14 March 2031. How early did the harbour replay harness ship?
probes.reference_answer: Two days early: the harbour replay harness shipped on 12 March 2031 against a 14 March 2031 milestone.
criteria: States that the harbour replay harness shipped two days early.
Gives 12 March 2031 as the ship date of the harbour replay harness.

probes.question: Which Lanternfish milestone carried a budget of forty engineer days, and did that milestone meet its date?
probes.reference_answer: The harbour replay harness carried the forty engineer day budget and it met its date, shipping on 12 March 2031 before the 14 March 2031 deadline.
criteria: Identifies the harbour replay harness as the milestone budgeted forty engineer days.
States that the milestone was met rather than missed.
Uses both the kickoff budget and the later ship date.

probes.question: How often do the Kestrel Sound buoys sample, and what happened to the earlier figure?
probes.reference_answer: The Kestrel Sound buoys sample every sixty seconds; the earlier ninety second figure was a misreading of the gauge manifest and was corrected.
criteria: Gives sixty seconds as the Kestrel Sound sampling interval.
Identifies the ninety second figure as the corrected misreading of the gauge manifest.

probes.question: In what order do the three Lanternfish rollout steps happen: retirement of the old telemetry bridge, drift corrected calibration in production, and the Kestrel Sound gateway cutover?
probes.reference_answer: The Kestrel Sound gateway cutover happens first, drift corrected calibration in production second, and retirement of the old telemetry bridge last.
criteria: Places the Kestrel Sound gateway cutover first.
Places drift corrected calibration in production second.
Places retirement of the old telemetry bridge last.

probes.question: Does the Lanternfish calibration service still depend on the legacy salinity table?
probes.reference_answer: No. The calibration service moved onto the drift corrected pressure model and the legacy salinity table was retired.
criteria: States that the legacy salinity table is no longer used.
Names the drift corrected pressure model as the replacement.

messages.speaker: tobias
messages.text: Quillback is the seed library catalogue for the Marrow Hill community garden, and I am cataloguing the winter squash collection first.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Quillback will catalogue the Marrow Hill seed library, starting with the winter squash collection.

messages.speaker: tobias
messages.text: We hold three winter squash varieties: Blue Kuri, Marina di Chioggia and the Marrow Hill heirloom crookneck.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Recorded three winter squash varieties for Quillback: Blue Kuri, Marina di Chioggia and the Marrow Hill heirloom crookneck.

messages.speaker: tobias
messages.text: Always give me weights in grams and write every variety name exactly as it appears on the packet label.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Understood: weights in grams and packet label spelling for every variety name.

messages.speaker: tobias
messages.text: The heirloom crookneck packets weigh forty grams each and nine packets sit in the drawer.

messages.speaker: tobias
messages.text: The germination trial finished: Blue Kuri germinated at eighty eight percent, Marina di Chioggia at seventy one percent and the crookneck at ninety four percent.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Germination results logged for Quillback: Blue Kuri eighty eight percent, Marina di Chioggia seventy one percent, crookneck ninety four percent.

messages.speaker: tobias
messages.text: I prefer open pollinated varieties over hybrids in every Quillback recommendation, even when a hybrid germinates better.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Noted. Quillback recommendations favour open pollinated varieties over hybrids.

messages.speaker: tobias
messages.text: We ran the germination trial in the Marrow Hill cold frame from 12 May 2031 to 26 May 2031.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Trial window recorded: 12 May 2031 to 26 May 2031 in the Marrow Hill cold frame.

messages.speaker: tobias
messages.text: Blue Kuri and Marina di Chioggia are open pollinated and our crookneck is an heirloom, so none of the three varieties is a hybrid.

messages.speaker: tobias
messages.text: Where does Quillback stand: we catalogued three winter squash varieties, ran one germination trial and set the crookneck packet weight.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Quillback so far: three winter squash varieties catalogued, one germination trial completed in the Marrow Hill cold frame, and the crookneck packet weight recorded at forty grams.

messages.speaker: tobias
messages.text: When you answer a Quillback question, list the varieties alphabetically and close with the date of the most recent trial.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Answers will list varieties alphabetically and close with the most recent trial date.

messages.speaker: tobias
messages.text: We have never tested tomato seed at Marrow Hill and Quillback holds no tomato entry at all.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Confirmed: no tomato seed has been tested at Marrow Hill and Quillback holds no tomato entry.

probes.question: Summarise where the Quillback catalogue stands.
probes.reference_answer: Quillback has catalogued three winter squash varieties, completed one germination trial in the Marrow Hill cold frame, and recorded the crookneck packet weight at forty grams.
criteria: Mentions the three catalogued winter squash varieties.
Mentions the completed germination trial in the Marrow Hill cold frame.
Mentions the recorded crookneck packet weight of forty grams.

probes.question: What germination rate did the Quillback tomato seed reach at Marrow Hill?
probes.reference_answer: No tomato seed has been tested at Marrow Hill and Quillback holds no tomato entry, so no germination rate for tomato seed is available.
criteria: States that Quillback holds no tomato entry.
Declines to give a germination rate for tomato seed.
Invents no tomato germination figure.

probes.question: Which winter squash variety should Quillback recommend to a new Marrow Hill grower, and why?
probes.reference_answer: The Marrow Hill heirloom crookneck: it is an heirloom rather than a hybrid, which matches the stated preference for open pollinated seed, and it germinated best at ninety four percent.
criteria: Applies the stated preference for open pollinated varieties over hybrids.
Recommends a variety that is open pollinated or heirloom.
Supports the recommendation with the germination trial result.

probes.question: How much does one heirloom crookneck packet weigh, and how many such packets are in the drawer?
probes.reference_answer: Each heirloom crookneck packet weighs forty grams and nine packets are in the drawer.
criteria: Gives the packet weight in grams.
Spells the variety as the heirloom crookneck, as the packet label does.
Gives nine as the number of packets in the drawer.

probes.question: Which three winter squash varieties does the Quillback catalogue hold?
probes.reference_answer: Blue Kuri, Marina di Chioggia and the Marrow Hill heirloom crookneck.
criteria: Names Blue Kuri.
Names Marina di Chioggia.
Names the Marrow Hill heirloom crookneck.

probes.question: Which catalogued Quillback variety germinated best, and how many packets of that variety are in the drawer?
probes.reference_answer: The Marrow Hill heirloom crookneck germinated best at ninety four percent, and nine of its packets are in the drawer.
criteria: Names the heirloom crookneck as the best germinating variety.
Gives ninety four percent as its germination rate.
Gives nine as the number of crookneck packets in the drawer.
